subject: website
name: Seedit
summary: Seedit, a peer-to-peer alternative to Reddit on the Plebbit/Bitsocial protocol, open source (GPL-3.0). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it reads its default community lists from raw.githubusercontent.com and reads chain state from public Ethereum RPC servers with no light client, and nothing checks either.

operations.name: Load default community lists
operations.note: Directory and default-subscription JSON files come from a GitHub-served file that nothing checks.

operations.name: Resolve names and read chain state
operations.note: Reads Ethereum state through public RPC endpoints, without a light client.

connections.name: Default community lists (raw.githubusercontent.com)
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens: the defaults list, default subscriptions and ten directory files.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC (publicnode.com, drpc.org, mevblocker.io, 1rpc.io, nodies.app)
connections.note: POST requests start within seconds of opening; the page reads chain state from these servers, with no light client.
